name: HyperSwap 1c_256 ONNX
notes: Tier 1. Drop-in replacement for inswapper_128.onnx. 2x output resolution (256px vs 128px). FaceFusion 3.3.0 + ReActor v0.6.2 (Apr 2026). ONNX interface unchanged. Also replaces build_faceswap_model default.

name: HyperSwap 1a/1b ONNX
notes: Tier 1. 1a=speed, 1b=balanced, 1c=quality. Same package as above. Bundle with build_faceswap update.

name: SAM 3.1
notes: Tier 1. Released Mar 27, 2026. Drop-in checkpoint upgrade over SAM 3. 2x throughput at 16 objects, 7x for 128+ objects. Apache 2.0 (gated HF access). Applies to build_sam3_mask, build_sam3_extract too.

name: SAM 3.1
notes: Tier 1. Same as build_sam3_segment entry.

name: SAM 3.1
notes: Tier 1. Same as build_sam3_segment entry.

name: Boogu-Image-0.1-Edit-Turbo
notes: Tier 1. IN-WINDOW Jul 8 2026. 10B Apache 2.0 instruction-editing model. Fixes quality regression in prior Edit-Turbo (object removal, general quality). ComfyUI-native via ComfyUI-Boogu + TextEncodeBooguEdit node. BF16/FP8/NVFP4/INT8 weights. Also available via Comfy-Org/Boogu-Image. Tutorial: docs.comfy.org/tutorials/image/boogu/boogu-image-0.1

name: LTX-2.3 (22B FP8)
notes: Tier 2. Released Mar 5 2026; HF repo file-touched Jul 9 2026. 22B, FP8 variant fits 16 GB (Lightricks/LTX-2.3-fp8). Native 4K/50fps, 20s clips, synchronized stereo audio. 8-step distilled variant. IC-LoRA ecosystem: LipDub, HDR, Motion-Track-Control, Decompression, Colorization, In-Outpainting, Ingredients, Cross-Eyed (all June 2026, gated access). ComfyUI native support Jun 2026.

name: Pixal3D (TencentARC)
notes: Tier 2. SIGGRAPH 2026. MIT license. Pixel-aligned image-to-3D on TRELLIS.2 backbone. GLB+PBR textures. GGUF ~6 GB (16 GB safe); standard ~24 GB on-disk runs at 16 GB limit (reduced 1024 res). ComfyUI nodes: dreamrec/ComfyUI-Pixal3D and Saganaki22/Pixal3D-ComfyUI.

name: Pixal3D (TencentARC)
notes: Tier 2. Same as build_hunyuan_3d_mesh entry. PBR texture output included.

name: DreamID-V (ByteDance)
notes: Tier 2. ECCV 2026. Apache 2.0. Video face-swap via Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B backbone. Temporal consistency vs MTB frame-by-frame. DreamID-V-Wan-1.3B-Faster recommended for 16 GB (boundary). Requires Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B VAE + text encoder + DWPose ONNX. ComfyUI: ComfyUI_RH_DreamID-V (HM-RunningHub) or ComfyUI_JR_DreamID-V (Goldlionren).

name: BFS-Best-Face-Swap (Klein 4B)
notes: Tier 2. MIT. 485K downloads. LoRA for Klein 4B/9B for still-image face+head swap. Use Klein 4B variant only (9B exceeds 16 GB). Covers range from subtle face swap to full head transfer. Video sibling: BFS-Best-Face-Swap-Video (based on Bernini-R, Jun 2026).

name: FlashVSR v1.1
notes: Tier 2. CVPR 2026. One-step streaming video SR. ~17fps at 768x1408, 12x faster than prior one-step VSR. ComfyUI: 1038lab/ComfyUI-FlashVSR. Speed tier alternative to SeedVR2 (SeedVR2 retains fidelity crown). Likely fits 16 GB; no official benchmark confirmed.

name: IConFace (FLUX.2-Klein-4B)
notes: Tier 2. arXiv 2605.02814, May 2026. Klein 4B backbone (~10-14 GB, fits 16 GB). No-ref + reference-guided (1-3 identity images) modes in one checkpoint. ComfyUI: cosmicrealm/ComfyUI-Flux-FaceIR. Weights: zhangjinyang/flux-restoration on HF. Inference-only release; limited community validation. Evaluate before promoting to default.

name: LTX-Best-Face-ID v1.0
notes: Tier 3. IN-WINDOW Jul 5/10 2026. Video identity LoRA for LTX-2.3 22B. ST-DRC conditioning (arXiv 2606.02441). ComfyUI via BFS Nodes (alisson-anjos/ComfyUI-BFSNodes). Character-sheet checkpoint also ships. VRAM FLAG: LTX-2 22B requires >16 GB — FP8 offload path for face-ID LoRA not validated at 16 GB. Promote only after quantized path confirmed.

name: WAN 2.7
notes: Tier 3. Apr 2026. Apache 2.0 on ModelScope. Native 1080p, 15s clips, audio, FLF integrated, 9-grid multi-image ref, video continuation. Official HF org not updated (still 2.2). ComfyUI partner node is API-only (cloud). Local: use kijai/WanVideo_comfy with community mirrors. 14B needs blockswap for 16 GB.

name: WAN 2.7 T2V
notes: Tier 3. Same as build_wan_video entry. T2V path now integrated in WAN 2.7 base model.

name: WAN 2.7 (FLF integrated)
notes: Tier 3. WAN 2.7 integrates FLF natively — separate FLF checkpoint may no longer be needed. Confirm on local node before deprecating build_wan_flf.

name: WAN 2.7 continuation mode
notes: Tier 3. WAN 2.7 video continuation covers build_wan_animate_video use case. Same caveats as above.

name: HiDream-O1-Image
notes: Tier 3. MIT. May 2026. 8B UiT — unified txt2img + instruction editing + personalization. Up to 2048x2048. PARTIAL ComfyUI node support. Needs quality validation vs Lumina2 before promoting.

name: Ideogram 4
notes: Tier 3. Jun 2026. 9.3B DiT. Best-in-class text-in-image rendering. Native 2K, transparency support. Official ComfyUI nodes (ideogram-oss/ComfyUI-Ideogram4). Non-commercial weights — verify license against Spellcaster deployment model before integrating.

name: FLUX.2-dev-Fun-Controlnet-Union
notes: Tier 3. Feb 2026. Multi-condition ControlNet for FLUX.2 Dev (Canny/Depth/Pose/HED/MLSD/Scribble/Grayscale + inpainting). Fills FLUX.2 ControlNet gap. Third-party node: bryanmcguire/comfyui-flux2fun-controlnet.

name: ColorFLUX
notes: Tier 3 (monitor). CVPR 2026. FLUX backbone colorization — structure-color decoupling. No public weights as of Jul 10. Watch for HF/GitHub release.

name: InfiniDepth
notes: Tier 3 (monitor). CVPR 2026. Arbitrary-resolution monocular depth. No ComfyUI node as of Jul 10. Potential DA3 complement for non-fixed resolution inputs.

name: MirrorPPR-Face
notes: Tier 3 (monitor). IN-WINDOW Jul 3-9 2026. ECCV 2026. Exemplar-based portrait retouching (not blind restoration). Requires reference exemplar at inference. No ComfyUI node. Different category from CodeFormer/GFPGAN.

name: ZipDepth
notes: Tier 3 (monitor). IN-WINDOW Jul 9 2026. 6.1M param lightweight monocular depth. ECCV 2026. No HF model card or ComfyUI node yet. Not a quality upgrade over DA3-Large; useful if fast/low-VRAM depth path needed.

name: OrbitQuant (quantization method)
notes: Tier 3 (monitor). IN-WINDOW Jul 3-4 2026. PTQ method for DiT video models (WAN, LTX-2.3, HunyuanVideo, FLUX). Enables 2-4 bit weight-activation quantization without per-model calibration. No ComfyUI node yet. Would reduce VRAM demands across all large video methods.
